title: Fixed-K Speculative Decoding vs. EAGLE-3: A Like-for-Like, Energy-Measured Comparison in vLLM and SGLang
description: Benchmark code, raw telemetry and paper for a like-for-like comparison of fixed-window draft-model speculative decoding (Llama-3.2-1B drafting K=5 tokens for Llama-3.1-8B) against EAGLE-3, EAGLE-1 and n-gram drafting inside vLLM and SGLang, with GPU energy per token read from the hardware energy counter. At batch size 1 on an RTX 5090, the draft-model configuration raises throughput by 60-79% and roughly halves energy per token compared with non-speculative decoding; a well-configured EAGLE-3 is 8-14% faster, with energy per token within about 10% either way. This is not a new algorithm: the contribution is the measurement protocol and results. See the README for scope and limitations.
